# The PR reviewer

Copied from `npwork/ai-small-projects`, `apps/cli/pr-review` at `1ba91ae`
(where its tests and bench live and where it is tuned), with only
`prompt.md`'s "About this repository" rewritten for this plugin.
`.github/workflows/review.yml` runs it on every PR. When the original changes
in a way worth having, copy it over again rather than tuning this copy.
